content_sections.heading: IIITNR Project Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Naya Raipur

content_sections.heading: About IIITNR
content_sections.text: International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Naya Raipur, referred to in the notice as IIITNR or IIIT-NR, is the institute inviting these applications. The posts are for coordination, registration, communication and documentation support. The institute's website named in the notice is www.iiitnr.edu.in .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is Any Graduate from a recognized university. All eligibility conditions and educational qualifications must be fulfilled on or before the closing date for receipt of applications, 24 November 2026. The upper age limit for the Project Assistant position is 40 years; the notice prints no age cut-off date and no age relaxation. Good written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Word. Basic computer knowledge and documentation skills. Ability to prepare presentations using MS PowerPoint. Knowledge of filing, data management and record maintenance. Candidates with prior experience in coordination, registration, communication, documentation or administrative support roles will be preferred. Candidates with relevant work experience and proficiency in the above-mentioned skills will be given preference. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A consolidated remuneration of ₹20,000/- per month (in-hand) will be provided, with no deductions. TA, DA and HRA will not be provided separately. The engagement is temporary and lasts 03 months. The post does not confer any right or claim for regularization or absorption at IIITNR.

content_sections.heading: IIITNR Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordination and assistance in organizing project-related activities. Registration and management of participant information and records. Communication and correspondence with participants and relevant stakeholders. Preparation, maintenance and management of project-related documentation. Data entry, record keeping and systematic filing of documents. Preparation of presentations, reports and other administrative materials.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITNR Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Fill the Google form at https://forms.gle/vq2iiV7rTrb2AWwS8 on or before 24 November 2026. Fill in all the required information. Incomplete or partially filled application forms will not be considered. For any query, write to [email protected] or call +91- 771-2474182. The notice also says the application portal link will be available on the Institute website, and applicants are expected to complete the online application form through that link. The notice names no documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates may be contacted for further selection procedures. The Institute reserves the right to shortlist only candidates whose profiles meet its requirements. In case of a large number of candidates, a written test may be conducted. The interview is a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 11:00 AM in the meeting room, New building. The date and time of the interview will be communicated only through the Institute website or email.
